articles.headline: Boozer, Stewart lead Memphis to a 136-105 victory over Kings as Grizzlies remain unbeaten
articles.description: — Rookie Cameron Boozer had 27 points and nine rebounds, Isaiah Stewart added 24 points as the Memphis Grizzlies remained the only unbeaten team in the NBA with a 136-105 victory over the Sacramento Kings on Saturday night.
